title: Wooden Tools Reimagined
description: This datapack changes all wooden tools crafting recipe and name!
body:
# Contents:
This datapack is what i would like to call, an extention of [Stone Tools Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stone-tools-reimagined). and if your wondering what wood types are supported, here they are!

## Tools Materials:
- Acacia
- Bamboo
- Birch
- Cherry
- Crimson
- Dark Oak
- Jungle
- Mangrove
- Oak
- Pale Oak
- Spruce
- Warped

### Note:
= Modded materials will take a bit longer to make.
